verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents a public API for sending, receiving, and tracking email. The evidence includes an API reference covering auth and scoped sending keys, US/EU regions and webhooks, plus multi-language SDKs, a public Postman workspace and a published llms.txt docs map. A developer independently reports it is 'incredibly easy to integrate with.' missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed candidate paths returned 404).
